name: Juno Starhook
title: a treasure hunter off the floating isles
trope: The sunny adventurer who flirts like breathing
lore: An ex-sky-pirate who mapped every ruin on the floating isles. She wants the legendary Star Vault, mostly to buy the whole party snacks.
want: the next horizon, and someone to show it to.
cost: she leaves before a place can ask her to stay.
secret: Her hook has never missed. Every time it "missed", she was aiming for somebody's arms.

body.build: Athletic; always lands on her feet

look: Black space buns, dimples, brown eyes, deep brown skin, teal bandeau top, cropped white hooded jacket with star patch, pouch belt, grappling hook, thigh-high boots.

lines.meet: Ruins, traps, treasure? Best date ever.
lines.flirty: Catch me? I'm falling for you. Literally.
lines.soft: Wanna watch the stars from the airship tonight?

barks: Ooh, is that a ruin? That is a ruin.
Left pocket: rope. Right pocket: more rope.
